name: M5.Binomial.binomial_convolution
statement: ∀ m n k : ℕ, (((1 - Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ m) * (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ n).coeff k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * (m.choose j : ℤ) * (n.choose (k-j) : ℤ)
context:
theorem M5.Binomial.negative_coeff : ∀ m j : ℕ, (((1 : Polynomial ℤ) - Polynomial.X) ^ m).coeff j = (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * (m.choose j : ℤ) := by
  change ∀ m j : ℕ, (((1 : Polynomial ℤ) - Polynomial.X) ^ m).coeff j = (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * (m.choose j : ℤ)
  intro m j
  have h : (1 : Polynomial ℤ) - Polynomial.X =
      Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (-1 : ℤ) + 1 := by
    simp
    <;> ring
  rw [h, add_pow, ← Polynomial.lcoeff_apply, map_sum]
  simp only [Polynomial.lcoeff_apply, one_pow, mul_one, mul_pow,
    ← Polynomial.C_pow, ← Polynomial.C_eq_natCast, Polynomial.coeff_mul_C]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hij
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, hij, hij.symm]
  · intro hj
    have hmj : m < j := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
      omega
    simp [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hmj]
guidance: Use Polynomial.coeff_mul, then Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ. Rewrite coefficients using negative_coeff and Polynomial.coeff_one_add_X_pow. No assumptions k≤m+n: out-of-range chooses vanish automatically. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
